finalText:
The bug was in `orderTotal` in `src/pricing.js`: it charged tax on the pre-discount amount instead of the discounted one, even though the comment right above it said tax should apply after the discount.

Changed line 41 from `cents * taxRate` to `discounted * taxRate`. All 625 tests pass now, and `verify.js` confirms it's fixed for real, not just papered over.
